product.title: Yellowstone National Park Private Wildlife Tour

description.text: Spend eight hours on a private wildlife tour through Lamar Valley, Hayden Valley, and Norris Geyser Basin with a naturalist guide. The route prioritizes bear and wolf habitat along river corridors and includes thermal boardwalk time when wildlife activity quiets in midday heat.

highlights: Hayden Valley bison and elk meadows
Norris Geyser Basin thermal boardwalk stop

start.description: Pickup from West Yellowstone or Gardiner area lodgings. Confirm your preferred gate when booking.

end.description: Return to your original pickup point after the Norris Geyser Basin or Hayden Valley final stop.

product.itinerarySummary: Spend eight hours on a private wildlife tour through Lamar Valley, Hayden Valley, and Norris Geyser Basin with a naturalist guide.

itineraryItems.title: Lamar Valley
itineraryItems.description: Early wildlife scanning in Lamar Valley for wolves, bears, and bison herds.

itineraryItems.title: Hayden Valley
itineraryItems.description: Open meadow wildlife viewing in Hayden Valley along the Yellowstone River.

itineraryItems.title: Mammoth Hot Springs
itineraryItems.description: Travertine terrace walk at Mammoth Hot Springs when routing from the north.

itineraryItems.title: Norris Geyser Basin
itineraryItems.description: Boardwalk loop through Norris Geyser Basin's hottest thermal features.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

Where does the tour depart from in Yellowstone National Park?
faqs.answer: Pickup from West Yellowstone or Gardiner area lodgings. Confirm your preferred gate when booking.
